### 新增
- 桌面客户端改为 Electron 壳，登录过期后自动续上
- 自定义 MCP 可填写 OAuth 应用凭证并完成授权
- 新增 `octop migrate openclaw` / `octop migrate hermes`，把原有助手迁到一个专家
- 知识库内的文档和文件夹可以移动。共享专家上可以分享对话
- 专家市场默认打开「精选」。管理员可按用户查看用量

### 变更
- 桌面端不再使用 Wails
- 升级 octop-harness 至 1.0.9、octop-memory 至 1.0.4

### 修复
- 下线
* fix(cloud): share Tencent Cloud logins through PostgreSQL by @jubaoliang in https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/pull/2854

* fix: keep the install runtime, bridge OpenSandbox file ops, and add TOS by @jubaoliang in https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/pull/2793
* fix(db): adapt executemany on the PostgreSQL connection proxy by @wxhking in https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/pull/2736
- PostgreSQL 可存放技能包和知识库。多实例共用定时任务、频道、头像、插件和已发布专家
- 安装清理不再删掉运行环境。PostgreSQL 上的知识库检索和关怀去重恢复正常
* feat: keep skill packag

### 新增
- 账号支持 TOTP 与 Passkey：二次验证、无密码登录和恢复码
- 新增 ragflow 知识库连接器

### 修复
- 记住登录会自动续期，改密码会退出其他设备。缺 MFA 表的旧库会自动补齐
- 极简模式里，专家会话超过 10 条可以继续展开。长代码在气泡里换行，已结束的一轮不会在历史加载后再出现一次
- 停用的会话模型回到 Auto。钉钉和微信切换时，草稿与二维码不再串台，登录回调会保留转

### 新增
- 建用户时可以同时创建一个默认专家。权限按页面 Tab 拆开，也可以按组折叠
- 用户组可以限制技能包、知识库、连接器、模型、存储和专家谁能看见
- 技能包可以共享，并用文件树编辑。创建专家、团队等资源时可以选头像
- 表单和对话可以让 AI 润色。搜索增加 DeepSeek 与元宝，模型支持 OpenAI Responses API

### 修复
- 云端协同共享后可以直接对话。回复进行中不会被刷新冲掉，

* docs(configuration): add password and url to database schema example by @Theater-ahyeon in https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/pull/896
- 回复操作始终可见；无 PostgreSQL 驱动时仍用 SQLite 启动
- 远程存储卡住堵住启动；S3 / Postgres 浏览；桌面 beta 覆盖安装；飞牛 8089 残留
- SQLite 写事务改用 `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`：多 worker（`octop run --workers N`）或 CLI 与服务并发写入时，先读后写的事务不再因快照过期而立即报 `database is locked`
* fix(docker): stop re-running octop init on restart with PostgreSQL (#1866) by @fengyue-xve in https://github.com/TencentCloud/Octop/pull/1868

- Windows 记忆备份恢复；微信旧库定时任务与重启后推送
- 审批放通、Steer 续跑，以及历史加载中消息消失

- 旧

- **Backups of MySQL 9.7** are no longer rejected with an incompatible-XtraBackup error. Use a Percona XtraBackup release from the same series as your server, for example PXB 9.7.x for MySQL 9.7.x.
- On MySQL 5.7 and Percona Server 5.7, the redo log checkpoint age metric is no longer exported while the server reports a placeholder value. Panels and alerts that relied on the placeholder now see a gap instead.
- [PMM-15189](https://perconadev.atlassian.net/browse/PMM-15189): Added documentation for starting a

- [PMM-15198](https://perconadev.atlassian.net/browse/PMM-15198): When you monitored MongoDB router (mongos) nodes in a sharded cluster, the exporter kept index statistics from only one shard and dropped the rest, and flooded the system logs with duplicate mongodb_indexstats_accesses_ops metric errors. Collection statistics could also be attributed to the wrong shard. Index and collection statistics are now labeled with the shard they come from, so you get complete and correctly attributed data from every s

This release also removes the provisioned PostgreSQL datasource as a security measure, adds Ubuntu 26.04 LTS support for PMM Client, and includes a large number of dashboard, UI, and stability fixes.
### Removed provisioned PostgreSQL datasource
PMM no longer includes a preconfigured PostgreSQL datasource for internal dashboard panels.
- [PMM-14931](https://perconadev.atlassian.net/browse/PMM-14931): You can now set ClickHouse memory configuration using the `PMM_CLICKHOUSE_CONFIG` environment variable inste

- Azure: Support `db_use_iam_auth` for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
- Crunchy Bridge: Detect cluster ID from internal hostnames (`i.*.db.postgresbridge.com`)

- Stop supporting Amazon Linux 2, RHEL 7, Debian 11 (Bullseye) and Ubuntu 20.04 (Focal)
  - These distributions are end of life
  - This raises the minimum glibc requirement to 2.28 (RHEL-based) and 2.34
    (Debian-based), which is now checked explicitly during the package build
- Allow disabling WebSocket use via config setting
  - By default the collector uploads snapshots over a WebSocket connection and
    falls back to HTTP when that fails. The new setting
    `api_disable_websocket` / `API_DIS

- Log Insights: Add classifications for additional Postgres log events
- Avoids rate limit issues when monitoring hundreds of database servers within
results of rds:DescribeDBInstances and rds:DescribeDBClusters for 60 seconds

- EXPLAIN normalization: Accept fractional Actual Rows for Postgres 18+
- Postgres settings: Fix parsing of array values in config (e.g. search_path)
